chunks: His is the supremacy in the heavens and the earth; and He is the all-mighty and all-wise.

key_terms.السَّمَاوَاتِ: The heavens; often used in the plural to denote the multiple layers of the cosmos.
key_terms.الْأَرْضِ: The earth; representing the terrestrial realm of creation.
key_terms.الْحَكِيمُ: The All-Wise; one who places things in their proper places and acts with perfect wisdom.
key_terms.الْعَزِيزُ: The Almighty, the Powerful; one who is unconquered and strong.
key_terms.الْكِبْرِيَاءُ: Supremacy, majesty, or grandeur; absolute dominion belonging to God.

ai.seo_question: What does Al-Kibriya mean in the context of Allah's attributes?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often linked to the concept of 'Al-Kibriya' as a unique attribute of Allah, distinct from the prideful arrogance (kibr) of creation, emphasizing His absolute sovereignty over the cosmos. The pairing of Power and Wisdom underscores that His dominion is not merely forceful but perfectly ordered, a theme central to understanding divine justice (Adl) in Shia theology. This affirmation serves as a reminder for believers to recognize their place within the grand design of the heavens and earth.
